title: BAFU 2026 v1 elementary flows → EF 3.1 characterization flow keys, by public matching
description: Third bafu-2026-v1 → ef-3.1 bridge, ranked below ranks 3 and 6; holds only flows neither maps. Generated by sentier-importers (sources/bafu/mappings_biosphere_matched, package matching/) from public inputs only: BAFU flow names, EF synonyms (sentier-vocab alt_labels), CAS numbers, qualifier spellings, a land-use class rule and a curated alias table, matched against the EF 3.1 flows that carry a factor in sentier-methods. Tier order: name, land-use class, synonym, qualifier, alias, the same tiers on the region-stripped name, then CAS. Placement is strict on sub-compartment (whole EF context leaf, same compartment) with one explicit, commented fallback to the EF unspecified context; land-use flows BAFU files under resources/unspecified or in ground are placed on EF land use with a comment. Target units are the EF reference units inferred from method membership (kilogram; kBq for radionuclides; cubic meter for water; megajoule for fossil energy resources; m2 or m2*a for land); a conversion_factor appears only for fixed same-substance factors (Bq→kBq, water kg→m3); every other dimension cross is withheld. Regionalised water and land names (Water, KR) carry the ISO code as target.location. Comments are caveats only. coverage.json is a non-normative sidecar with one row for every bafu-2026-v1 flow: mapped (bridge 3, 6 or 7, tier, placement) or unmapped with a reason (no_ef_flow, sub_compartment_absent, non_ef_compartment, unit_mismatch, speciation, ambiguous_substances, non_freshwater, qualifier_missing); rows of substances whose source CAS values conflict carry cas_conflict. Regenerate with a fresh --cache-dir: python -m sentier_importers run bafu-ef-biosphere-matched --deliver-local ~/dds/sentier-mappings, then the same for bafu-ef-coverage.
